summary: Teaches creating query, custom and chained dashboard variables and using them in panel queries.

needs.description: Grafana Cloud Prometheus data source (grafanacloud-<stack>-prom) selected in the Query Variable editor.
needs.evidence: create-query-variable: "select your Grafana Cloud Prometheus data source"; Before you begin: at least one Prometheus data source

needs.description: Series `up` carrying `environment` and `cluster` labels (variable queries label_values(up, environment) and a cluster query filtered by environment) so previews and dependent variables return values.
A saved, editable dashboard containing at least one panel querying the Prometheus data source (steps say "Open your dashboard and click Edit"; use-variables step edits an existing panel query).
needs.evidence: "Open your dashboard and click **Edit**"; "panel that you want to update... Edit"

needs.description: Test user with Editor or Admin role able to create/edit dashboards.
needs.evidence: Before you begin: permissions to create and edit dashboards; manifest userRoleIn Editor/Admin

reviewNotes: Dashboard the guide expects the learner to already have is not named; a seeded dashboard (or one created by an earlier path) is assumed.
